caption: Sint-Margaretakerk, Norg
composition: Romanesque brick church and saddle-roof tower on the brink · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Sint-Margaretakerk stands on the brink at Norg. The tower is an unarticulated saddle-roof tower with white-plastered round-arched niches, not a spire. The nave is a brick hall and the choir ends in a semicircle. It is overcast, about 9.5°C, with wind near 4.7 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. The church is closed. No coat of arms is readable. This is not a hunebed.
